entries.title: Job 13:1
segments: Lo, mine eye hath seen all [this], Mine ear hath heard and understood it.

entries.title: Job 13:2
segments: What ye know, [the same] do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

entries.title: Job 13:3
segments: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, And I desire to reason with God.

entries.title: Job 13:4
segments: But ye are forgers of lies; Ye are all physicians of no value.

entries.title: Job 13:5
segments: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! And it would be your wisdom.

entries.title: Job 13:6
segments: Hear now my reasoning, And hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

entries.title: Job 13:7
segments: Will ye speak unrighteously for God, And talk deceitfully for him?

entries.title: Job 13:8
segments: Will ye show partiality to him? Will ye contend for God?

entries.title: Job 13:9
segments: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceiveth a man, will ye deceive him?

entries.title: Job 13:10
segments: He will surely reprove you If ye do secretly show partiality.

entries.title: Job 13:11
segments: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, And his dread fall upon you?

entries.title: Job 13:12
segments: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defences are defences of clay.

entries.title: Job 13:13
segments: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak; And let come on me what will.

entries.title: Job 13:14
segments: Wherefore should I take my flesh in my teeth, And put my life in my hand?

entries.title: Job 13:15
segments: Behold, he will slay me; I have no hope: Nevertheless I will maintain my ways before him.

entries.title: Job 13:16
segments: This also shall be my salvation, That a godless man shall not come before him.

entries.title: Job 13:17
segments: Hear diligently my speech, And let my declaration be in your ears.

entries.title: Job 13:18
segments: Behold now, I have set my cause in order; I know that I am righteous.

entries.title: Job 13:19
segments: Who is he that will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the ghost.

entries.title: Job 13:20
segments: Only do not two things unto me; Then will I not hide myself from thy face:

entries.title: Job 13:21
segments: Withdraw thy hand far from me; And let not thy terror make me afraid.

entries.title: Job 13:22
segments: Then call thou, and I will answer; Or let me speak, and answer thou me.

entries.title: Job 13:23
segments: How many are mine iniquities and sins? Make me to know my transgression and my sin.

entries.title: Job 13:24
segments: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And holdest me for thine enemy?

entries.title: Job 13:25
segments: Wilt thou harass a driven leaf? And wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

entries.title: Job 13:26
segments: For thou writest bitter things against me, And makest me to inherit the iniquities of my youth:

entries.title: Job 13:27
segments: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, And markest all my paths; Thou settest a bound to the soles of my feet:

entries.title: Job 13:28
segments: Though I am like a rotten thing that consumeth, Like a garment that is moth-eaten.
